messages.text: We agree on Relief, and the Ascendant has now confirmed Grey Petrel is lodged correctly. I support that written directive. The repair requirement next month must be treated as part of the cost of today's accommodation; repeated demands on a weakening route are not sustainable. Our trade contributes to the military opportunity without becoming compulsory carriage.

Your confirmation resolves my funding objection. I support Relief under the lodged reserve arrangement. The expected Beacon one makes next month's funded Repair an essential subject for the post-resolution bargain.

reason: Both the Navigation discussion and the addressed imperial note now support the same funded operation. I have no remaining objection to Relief on today's locked assets. This assent concerns an operational order only and grants no constitutional signature or standing commitment.
